name: maxprofit
description: Runtime: Node.js Input: terminal Runtime input: only n Building configuration: fixed from the problem statement Algorithm: top-down DP + memoization State: currentTime Memo: maximum additional profit for each currentTime Choice tracking: remember which building produced the maximum so we can output T/P/C Invalid n: reject anything other than a non-negative integer Tie: any optimal solution is acceptable; we'll keep the first maximum encountered. No external packages: use Node's built-in input functionality.
